column1: Stats Calculator - final stats for any build
Mirrors Stats.Compute: base + rod/line/bait + aura + passes + mastery + rebirth + skills, then clamped by Min/Max. Yellow cells are the build; the table shows each source.
Percent stats (Luck, BiteSpeed, ...) are fractions: 0.5 = +50%. Bag capacity is not a stat; see Items.
